film.title: The Last Watch
film.promptPreamble: Photorealistic expressionist maritime cinema in stark black-and-white, composed for an exact almost-square 1.10:1 frame inherited from the first-frame keyframe. Orthochromatic tonal response renders skin pale, sky chalky, wool and wet rock nearly black. Hard practical light, deep crushed shadows, silver halation, coarse 35mm grain, slight gate weave, salt haze, real spray and condensation. Consistent characters: THE KEEPER is a lean weathered man in his late sixties with grey stubble, near-black wool coat, thick dark scarf and black boots; THE RELIEF is a woman in her early thirties with cropped dark curls, pale slick oilskin, black sweater and brown canvas tool roll. Claustrophobic, severe, human, and grounded. Realtime speed, brisk natural motion, precise physical action. Diegetic sound only. Keep every frame subtitle-free and free of flags, brands, dialogue, logos, watermarks, readable labels, and on-screen lettering.

shots.prompt:
The opening frame matches the provided keyframe: a remote white lighthouse rises through a pearl-grey dusk, its lamp dark, while a wet path and cottage compress beneath it in the exact 1.10:1 frame.
Shot 1: wide exterior pushes toward the vertical tower as wind lashes long grass sideways; THE RELIEF climbs the lower path carrying her brown tool roll and a distinct compact dark motor case; <hard coastal wind, distant surf, boots on gravel>.
Shot 2: cut inside the cottage to a hard-lit hand close-up; THE KEEPER presses a small dark suitcase shut and snaps both latches; <two metal latch clicks, window frame rattling>.
Shot 3: cut to a long-lens close through wet glass; he sees the motor case first, then lifts his eyes to the relief approaching below; <coat cloth under wind, rain ticking glass>.

The opening frame matches the provided keyframe: THE KEEPER and THE RELIEF face each other across the open iron door in a cramped vertical two-shot, her dark motor case hanging at her side.
Shot 1: close wide-angle track as she offers her right hand; he takes the motor case instead, sets it against the stone wall and slams the door against the gale; <case on stone, iron hinge groan, door slam, wind muffling>.
Shot 2: cut to a tight table insert; she reaches toward the large dark iron service key, but his hand closes around it first and clips it to his belt; <keys scraping wood, one metal chime>.
Shot 3: cut to a locked two-shot split by the spiral stair; he sets two enamel mugs far apart and climbs while she looks once at the shelved case, then follows; <ceramic on wood, first iron footfalls>.

The opening frame matches the provided keyframe: in the machinery room, a vertical guarded weight chain divides THE KEEPER from THE RELIEF; his hands are empty and her grey vibration meter is ready.
Shot 1: low vertical track as he draws the large dark iron service key from inside his coat, fits it and winds the counterweight upward before leaning close to the gear rhythm; <chain lifting, even clockwork tick, his measured breath>.
Shot 2: cut to macro; she clamps the meter to the housing, its blank needle kicks, and she stops one visibly thinned chain link between gloved fingers; <clamp click, harsh vibration buzz, chain knock>.
Shot 3: cut to a locked confrontation; she holds a clean spare link beside the worn one, but he returns the spare to her roll, pockets the key and winds the weight one turn higher; <fresh link chime, ratchet clacking, strained metal knock>.

The opening frame matches the provided keyframe: a hard-lit radio room above a fogging sea window, both keepers small beneath it as storm rain erases the horizon.
